'''Isolationist Wookiees''' was the name given to a group of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] who chose to abandon their [[City/Legends|cities]] and instead live a hidden existence in the jungles of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. They formed during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] once they took control of the Wookiee [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] and turned oversight of it to [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]]. Isolationist Wookiees believed that offworlders were not to be trusted and were quick to judge them, as they saw them as being supporters of either the Empire or Trandoshans, or even both.
